x-luckread.effective-boundary: trial_ends_at is the only trial access boundary; canceling conversion does not remove access before that time.

x-transitions.guard: Web subscriber cancellation sets Subscription.cancel_at to trial_ends_at with If-Match; store cancellation is accepted only from the W02-verified RevenueCat current customer snapshot with unsubscribe_detected_at. Subscription remains TRIALING through trial_ends_at.
Only a verified failed Hyperswitch first MIT renewal outcome may move a WEB trial Subscription from TRIALING to PAST_DUE; D1-01 synchronizes its linked trial record.

A verified successful Hyperswitch first MIT renewal for WEB or a W02-verified RevenueCat NORMAL paid period for store trial advances the existing Subscription current_period_start to trial_ends_at or later and sets ACTIVE.

The store expiry state is confirmed by W02-verified RevenueCat current customer snapshot; a WEB trial expires only after trial_ends_at and only when no in-flight, uncertain, or still-retryable first MIT renewal exists.
The trial_ends_at boundary has passed and source authority confirms there is no paid conversion.
A later bounded Hyperswitch retry succeeds and advances the same Subscription into a paid ACTIVE period.
The renewal retry budget is exhausted or no valid MIT mandate remains, and trial_ends_at has passed.

reconciliation.webStart: Only an active Hyperswitch MIT mandate joined to a saved payment method permits W07 to start a web trial; D1-01 creates Subscription and trial record atomically.
reconciliation.storeStart: App Store and Play Store trial state is created only by W07 reconciliation of a current RevenueCat snapshot after W02 confirms the App User ID maps to the authenticated subscriber. Client-supplied store claims and webhook raw bodies do not grant access.
reconciliation.firstCharge: WEB first charge reuses the existing W07 renewal-cycle, D1-04 Order/Payment and Hyperswitch MIT pipeline at trial_ends_at; no separate trial billing service or duplicate subscription is created.
reconciliation.storeConversion: Store trial-to-paid conversion is reconciled from RevenueCat current entitlement period_type and effective expiration, not charged by W07.
reconciliation.cancellation: Canceling a web trial suppresses future conversion but preserves access until trial_ends_at; store cancellation remains under App Store/Google Play controls and RevenueCat status.
reconciliation.retry: A failed first MIT attempt moves WEB Subscription to PAST_DUE and trial record to PAYMENT_FAILED; the same renewal cycle may retry against the same mandate and cannot be expired while retryable.
reconciliation.expiry: Store trials expire only from W02-verified RevenueCat snapshot; WEB trials expire in the existing bounded renewal scheduler only after checking for pending/submitted/retryable D1-04 cycles.
reconciliation.noEarlyEntitlement: No trial, paid conversion or expiry transition may be claimed from client input or an unverified webhook.
